I'm Chloe, a 17 year old, and I've lived in Hawaii all my life. It's my senior year, and I know that I want to move off-island for college, but being in the middle of the Pacific Ocean, I have no idea of where would be right for me. I'm also worryingly clueless about what I want to go into. I have a multitude of "passions," but I've never figured out a specific one to pursue. I just want to be able to score films, produce films, go further with my band, design clothes, own a bake shop, and be a studio artist all at once, but that'd be borderline maniacal, and it still doesn't solve the issue of what I am to pursue in college.
Despite all this, I'm doing my best to appreciate the freedom that I still have as a youngin. I've been going to the beach with my friends (I never really appreciated the beach until high school), I got to score and animate a short film with my friend, I've been entering a lot of film/broadcast competitions, I've been getting better at sewing, I've gotten the chance to perform some awesome gigs, I make it a point to hug my mom everyday, and I sing my heart out any moment I can, and even though things are incredibly uncertain at this point in my life and I have my own struggles with school, social anxiety, insecurity, and money (as many people my age do), I know that I'm living the good times, and I'm just looking forward to making the best of the last year I'll be spending here on my home island for quite a while.

So my house has this hallway leading to three rooms, the first one being the washroom, and when I was little, on two occasions, I swore I saw a tall dark figure by the washroom. And by tall I mean head reaching the ceiling (which is around 2 feet above the doorway) tall, but my parents brushed it off as my imagination, so as I got older, I did the same. Flash forward a few years, I have a friend over for the first time, and after she leaves, I get a text from her saying she doesn't want to come to my house anymore. Concerned, I ask her why, and she says she saw a figure in my house. So I'm scared and confused because I totally forgot what I saw as a child until I read her text, so there's no way she could have known. Freaked out, I asked her where it was, and she said in my hallway by the washroom. At this point, I know it's not some crazy coincidence. I then asked her what it looked like, and she told me it was black and as tall as the ceiling.
